critical_code_review_comments: Coordinator role correctly implemented: can_control=true but can_stream_video=false for coordinators
Slide drive bar shows only for roles with can_drive_slides=true (host, coordinator, presenter)
Room-info correctly determines my_role based on: host_id > active_roles > coordinator_emails > panelist_emails > attendee
Promote/demote endpoints enforce authorization: only host can promote to coordinator, coordinators cannot demote other coordinators
Transcription endpoints properly structured: /transcript/{id} returns status/transcription/error, upload sets transcription_status=queued
WebRTC signaling connects to WS at /api/karau-meet/ws/webinar-{id} for peer-to-peer video
seed_data_creation: Created test webinar with coordinator_emails during backend testing. Local recordings present but no cloud recordings with transcription status.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 142 verified coordinator role, transcription, and WebRTC features. Role hierarchy: host > coordinator > presenter > panelist > attendee. Coordinator has can_control=true but can_stream_video=false. Slide drive bar shows for can_drive_slides=true roles. Transcription auto-triggers on cloud upload (sets status=queued). Current recordings are local type - need cloud upload to test transcription UI badges. WebRTC signaling uses existing WS endpoint. Camera access denied in headless mode is expected behavior.
